title: 15m optimal-trade-entry pullback: buy a rejection in the 0.618-0.79 retracement of a 3% impulse leg, target the leg high
rule_summary: Chart 15m, closed bars; signal at bar close, fill at next open. IMPULSE LEG at bar t: H = highest high of bars t-24..t-2 at index h (latest if tied); L = lowest low of bars h-32..h-1 at index l. Require (H-L)/L >= 3.0% and that no bar from h+1 to t closed above H. FIB LEVELS: E = H - 0.618*(H-L) (entry level), X = H - 0.79*(H-L) (deepest allowed). The leg is cancelled if any low from h+1 to t-1 went below X. ACTIVITY FILTER (fixed): Wilder ATR(14)/close >= 0.4% at t. ENTRY when flat: low(t) <= E, low(t) >= X, close(t) > E and close(t) > open(t) (a rejection candle inside the 0.618-0.79 zone). One entry per leg (same L and H). STOP = 0.998*L (just beyond the leg's 1.0 level; risk about 0.38*(H-L), at least 1.1% of price). TARGET = H (the 0.0 level). EXITS: stop or target intrabar; time exit at the open 48 bars (12h) after entry. At most 3 entries per pair per UTC day.
mechanism: TradeZella's PO3/OTE playbook (ICT): after a displacement leg, enter on a pullback to the 0.62-0.79 retracement, stop beyond the leg origin, target the leg high; entering only deep in the pullback keeps reward to risk near 1.6R whatever the size of the move. Who pays: profit-takers and short-term faders who sell the first pullback of a fresh impulse; buyers who missed the impulse, and the initiator still working orders, absorb that supply near 0.618. Distinct from HolyGrail (EMA touch) and VWAP pullbacks: the level comes from the leg itself, and a 3% leg only forms in active markets. Cost: risk at least 1.1% (0.27R or less); target about +1.85% on a 3% leg. Gross estimate about 0.5% at a 45% hit rate. The source is discretionary; its fib levels are used as published.
